name: email-client-v2
description: Gmail-like email client — Vite SPA + Hono Cloudflare Worker, reusing existing D1/R2.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

bindings.DB: D1 database holding mail, aliases, labels, drafts and settings
bindings.EMAIL_CACHE: R2 bucket for raw .eml files and attachments
bindings.EMAIL: Email Routing send_email binding used for replies/compose
